ICW.title: International Confederation of Wizards
ICW.description: The International Confederation of Wizards (ICW) is a non-governmental organization that promotes the use of magic and wizardry in the world. It is dedicated to promoting the use of magic and wizardry in the world. The ICW is a non-profit organization that is dedicated to promoting the use of magic and wizardry in the world.

UNCSW.title: United Nations Commission on the Status of Women
UNCSW.description: The United Nations Commission on the Status of Women (UNCSW) is a functional commission of the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC). It is dedicated to promoting gender equality and empowering women worldwide. The Commission plays a crucial role in shaping global standards for gender equality and fostering international cooperation to address women's rights issues.

UNSC.title: United Nations Security Council
UNSC.description: The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations (UN) and is charged with ensuring international peace and security, recommending the admission of new UN members to the General Assembly, and approving any changes to the UN Charter. The UNSC is the only UN body with the authority to issue binding resolutions on member states. The Security Council was created after World War II to address the failings of the League of Nations in maintaining world peace. The Security Council consists of fifteen members, of which five are permanent: China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

AIPPM.title: All India Political Parties Meet
AIPPM.description: All India Political Party Meet is a non-technical but powerful committee. It is a meeting between all the political parties of the nation. Typically called before the session of the Parliament or before the introduction of a bill, this committee aims to arrive at a consensus before the sessions begin. It is a supplementary body to the Parliament without any legislative provisions. The purpose of the meetings is to provide a forum for unbounded political debate and to foster consensus on key national issues.

WTO.title: World Trade Organization
WTO.description: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is an intergovernmental organization that regulates international trade. It provides a framework for negotiating trade agreements, resolving disputes, and ensuring that trade flows as smoothly, predictably, and freely as possible. The WTO aims to reduce barriers to trade, promote fair competition, and foster global economic cooperation.
